mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both series decline from prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 95), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate production and profit margins, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO is below 95, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales figure (RSAFS above 330,000 million dollars) consistently signals robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 330,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500,000 units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the risk of aggressive monetary tightening.
regime_hint: high inflation and low interest rates
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5.
